lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: okay... Storybook rules. no one dies. they just get flipped.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: but i still lost my mom. she got flipped to The Red.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: and i'm really small. like, pocket-sized wizard small. so... um.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: i heard 'The Red' and 'lost mom' and i figured i'd either help or steal something. hi.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: hi... hi. sorry. i'm sorry. i know that's not a greeting.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: it is if you're a distressed hedgehog wizard.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i have the Flipper. it's a hat. it's real. my mom found it, and now it's on my head, and i look ridiculous, and i don't care.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: a magic hat that flips The Red-corrupted characters back to normal. cool. also, it does suit you in a 'tiny menace' way.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: thank you. sorry.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: why are you apologizing for thank you.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i'm sorry, i do that when i'm scared.

options.text: ask for help honestly (a little teary)

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: would you... maybe... help me? i can pay you in snacks and gratitude and not biting.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: strong offer. low bite rate. tempting.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i need help. Storybook is getting taken by The Red, and my mom is Red now. i have the Flipper, but i can't do this alone.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: that's... actually pretty brave for someone who could fit in a teacup.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: please help. i know i'm tiny and annoying and i say sorry too much.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: you're not annoying. you're just... aggressively polite.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: so what's the catch. there's always a catch in Storybook.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: the catch is... i already flipped you.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: you what.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i'm sorry!! i panicked! you looked like you were going to say no and then vanish into a different page!

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: one moment i'm minding my business in 'Hedgehog and Pig Friends' and the next i am magically obligated to be helpful.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i can unflip you after we find my mom. i promise. cross my tiny heart.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: that's the most illegal-sounding friendship pitch i've ever heard.

options.text: promise you'll make it up to him (be sincere)
promise you'll stop flipping friends (be hopeful)

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: Storybook is supposed to be cozy. different books, stitched together like one big shelf.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: and now the shelf is on fire, metaphorically. mostly.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: The Red corruption flips people. makes them act wrong. like their cute little story got overwritten.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: yeah. they go from 'gentle side character' to 'evil monologue enjoyer' real fast.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: my mom got flipped, but i kept the Flipper. so i can flip Red people back.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i just need... a team. a real team. not just me and my tiny hat.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: fine. i'm in. not because you flipped me. definitely not because you're adorable. purely business.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: thank you... sorry... thank you.

options.text: ask rogue for a plan (trust him)

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: we find muscle. we find food. then we find clues.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: food is part of the plan?

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: it is if we recruit the right kind of muscle.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: a tank who likes to eat?

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: exactly. also, i would like to note i did not volunteer for this. you flipped me.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i know. i'm sorry.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: say it one more time and i will flip myself back out of spite.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: okay. i will be... responsibly grateful.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: stand aside. i am on a sacred quest.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: is the sacred quest... food?

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: yes.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: perfect. we need you for a different sacred quest.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: does it have food?

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i can make sure it has food. i promise. sorry, i mean-- i promise.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: acceptable.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: okay, wizard. do the thing.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: uhm. hi. sorry. i'm tiny. please don't be mad.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: why are you apologizing while wearing a hat like that.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: because it's the Flipper and it solves arguments.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: flip.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: oh. i suddenly feel like helping. suspicious.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: welcome to being on our team. i hate it here too.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i need help finding my mom. she got flipped to The Red.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: The Red are messing up Storybook. i have seen cute places become weird and angry.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: she has the Flipper, so we can flip corrupted people back as we go.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: a hat that fixes people. nice. can it flip soup into more soup?

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: not yet. but i'm working on it.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: i will help, but i require food at regular heroic intervals.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: agreed. feeding you is cheaper than carrying you.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: i am large, not luggage.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: okay. team assembled. wizard, rogue, tank.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: from 'Hedgehog and Pig Friends' plus one guest star from some other book.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: i am the best guest star.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: now we flip anyone The Red corrupted, and we follow the trail to my mom.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: we flipped... a lot of people.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: i flipped three. then i ate. then i flipped two more. excellent day.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: The Red corruption is spreading. whole crowds are getting that blank stare.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: and you three are making a mess of my clinic.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: oh! hi! sorry! you're a talking cat healer!

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: yes. Storybook. keep up. also, you flipped my patients in the waiting room.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i'm sorry. they were Red. i panicked. i'm very small.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: to be fair, they were trying to bite us.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: to be fair, everyone is trying to bite everyone lately. The Red does that.

options.text: ask about The Red immediately (be urgent)

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: we're looking for my mom. she was flipped to The Red. i'm trying to flip people back with the Flipper.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: the Flipper. right. a hat that turns Red ink back into Storybook ink.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: can it turn stew into more stew

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: no.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: tragic.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: listen. if your mom is Red, she will be drawn toward where The Red pools.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: where.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: the Red Desert. all of The Red drift there eventually. like spilled ink finding the lowest page.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: the Red Desert... okay. okay. thank you. sorry. thank you.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: bring water. bring bandages. bring patience. and please stop flipping people inside my clinic.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: no promises. but we'll try.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: Red Desert it is. if The Red took my mom, i'm taking her back.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: i am taking snacks.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: i am taking the lead. also, wizard, remember: you don't always have to flip people to make friends.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: noted. but it really speeds things up. sorry.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: go. and if you see my other patients out there, flip them gently.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: okay, before we head toward the Red Desert, quick question.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: if the question is 'may i pet you', the answer is no.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: i didn't even ask yet!

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: your hands asked. your eyes asked. your entire vibe asked.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: i think the rogue is trying to flip the healer into being pettable.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: i am not. i am simply appreciating a talking cat healer. respectfully.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: your 'respectfully' has grabby fingers.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: um. hi. sorry. please don't fight.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: enough! we are literally chasing The Red and you are arguing about petting.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: fair.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: finally, a tiny wizard with authority.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: okay okay okay, rogue, hands to yourself. healer, you're very majestic. everyone wins.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: i can be normal. i can be so normal.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: prove it by not moving.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i'm sorry, i just... i can't handle fighting right now.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: okay. okay. i'm done. no petting. i will pet the air.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: good. pet the air. heal the mood.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: tank? can i tell you something about my mom?

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: yes. and i will listen with my whole heart. and maybe my stomach.

options.text: she's the smartest wizard in Storybook. (admiring)
she made me feel safe, even when pages got dark. (soft)
she taught me magic like it was cooking. a pinch of this, a dash of that. (cute)

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: she reads spells like other people read picture books. like it's easy. like the ink listens.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: then The Red picked the wrong wizard to mess with.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: when Storybook felt scary, she would just... sit with me. like her magic was being calm.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: that is real magic.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: she said spells are like recipes. if you rush, it burns. if you're patient, it becomes something warm.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: i respect this philosophy deeply.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: We will save her.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: okay. okay. thank you. i believe you.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: we'll flip her back. and then, if i behave, maybe i get one single pet.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: no.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i am trying so hard to be brave.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: but i'm getting really, really frustrated.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: because The Red keeps spreading, and everyone keeps needing flipping, and my legs are tiny, and this hat is heavy, and i miss my mom.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: do you want snacks.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: yes. and also no. and also yes.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: okay. that's a real frustration cocktail.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: symptoms include: stomping, huffing, and heroic despair.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i don't even stomp loudly. i'm like a polite little pencil tapping.

options.text: try to be nice but fail (adorable meltdown)

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: and you keep joking and petting and acting like this is normal!

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: hey. i joke because if i don't, i start screaming.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: well i am one missed nap away from screaming.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: and you keep talking about food like my mom is a side dish!

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: no. food is how i stay strong so i can help you save her.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: oh. sorry. i mean-- i heard that. thank you.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i'm fine! i'm totally fine! i'm just-- i'm just a tiny hedgehog carrying a world-saving hat while Storybook gets eaten by The Red!

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: that's not 'fine'. that's 'legendary'.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: also that's called burnout.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: i just want one thing to be easy.

lines.speaker: healer
lines.text: then make one thing easy. drink water. breathe. accept help.

lines.speaker: rogue
lines.text: and if The Red wants a fight, we give it a very organized fight.

lines.speaker: tank
lines.text: with snacks.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: fine. yes. snacks. but also... thank you. all of you.

lines.speaker: wizard
lines.text: okay. let's go. Red Desert. mom. Flipper. no more losing pages.
